title: The Strategic Marketing Plan
overview: A well-structured marketing plan is essential to defining the key marketing elements of a business, aligning objectives, and outlining activities for both the company and its employees. This course delves into critical components of a company’s marketing and promotion strategy, including the marketing mix (the 4Ps), evaluating market opportunities, conducting research, analyzing and identifying target markets, and crafting a strategic market position. Participants will gain insights into the entire process, from developing and implementing the marketing plan to measuring and assessing the outcomes of their marketing efforts.
audience: This course is highly valuable for general managers, marketing managers, product and sales managers. It also benefits market researchers, planning managers, and other professionals involved in the creation and execution of marketing plans.
methodology: The course combines case studies and practical exercises designed to build the necessary skills for developing and managing a strategic marketing plan. Group presentations and discussions on various aspects of strategic marketing will also be a key feature of the training.
competencies: Creating a Boston Consulting Group (BCG) matrix
Structuring and developing a comprehensive marketing plan
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Apply a systematic process to develop an effective marketing plan
Build a marketing plan based on insights from a marketing audit
Utilize marketing audit data to shape effective strategies and tactics
Construct the essential components of a strategic marketing plan
Understand and apply various marketing warfare strategies (offensive, defensive, and flanking)
